status..validate: newData.val() == 'CREATING' || newData.val() == 'LOBBY' || newData.val() == 'STARTING' || newData.val() == 'IN_GAME' || newData.val() == 'PAUSED' || newData.val() == 'RECONNECTING' || newData.val() == 'COMPLETED' || newData.val() == 'ABANDONED'

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['id', 'name', 'color']) && newData.child('id').val() == $uid && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length > 0 && newData.child('name').val().length <= 30 && (newData.child('color').val() == 'RED' || newData.child('color').val() == 'GREEN' || newData.child('color').val() == 'YELLOW' || newData.child('color').val() == 'BLUE')

$actionId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['actionId', 'type', 'playerId']) && (!data.exists()) && newData.child('actionId').isString() && newData.child('playerId').isString() && newData.child('payload').val().length < 256 && (newData.child('type').val() == 'ROLL_DICE' || newData.child('type').val() == 'MOVE_PIECE' || newData.child('type').val() == 'PASS_TURN' || newData.child('type').val() == 'SET_READY' || newData.child('type').val() == 'START_GAME' || newData.child('type').val() == 'LEAVE_ROOM')
